name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.OrderLock.pinned_walk_lock
title: Pinned class lock for any level order: with some levels pinned to fixed values, class-covered slot moves and cover flips below depth l never create an all-ones slot
statement: Slot programs m : N -> Bool -> Bool, alive on x when m i (x i) = true for all i. Fix a depth l, pinned levels (pin i = true) with values v, and z assigning to each program a string that depends only on its entries at the non-pinned levels below l, equals v at pinned levels, and lies in the program's cube at the non-pinned levels below l whenever these are nonempty. If at time 0 no slot is alive on its own z, and every step changes one slot d either so that each string alive in the new d is alive, before the step, in a slot with the same entries at the non-pinned levels below l, or by a cover flip at a level L < l (cover c agrees with d below L, c L b = true, c is all ones after L, and only the entry (L, b) of d changes), then no slot is ever all-ones.
